statement: We present the first I/O optimal data structure for the non-overlapping indexing problem in both cache-award and cache-oblivious models of computation. We remark that by combining our framework with standard techniques, we can design an I/O optimal, O(n log2 n) space structure for the range non-overlapping problem in the cache-aware model. However, it is not clear if the same is possible in cache-oblivious model. An interesting question is: Can we improve the space (yet, keeping the query I/Os optimal), at least in the cache-award model ?
